title: My first flight
summary: A boy remembers the first time he took a plane.

sentences.en: As a child I had never been on a plane.

sentences.zh: 十岁那年，我和爸爸妈妈去北京旅游，我第一次坐飞机。
sentences.en: When I was ten, I went to Beijing on holiday with Mum and Dad; it was my first flight.

sentences.zh: 飞机早上八点飞，我们五点就起床了。
sentences.en: The plane left at eight, and we got up as early as five.

sentences.zh: 虽然很早，但是我一点儿也不累。
sentences.en: Although it was early, I wasn't tired at all.

sentences.zh: 我们六点半就到机场了。
sentences.en: We got to the airport by half past six.

sentences.zh: 飞机上，我很喜欢看外面。
sentences.en: On the plane, I loved looking outside.

sentences.zh: 外面有很多白色的云，太漂亮了！
sentences.en: Outside there were lots of white clouds — so beautiful!

sentences.zh: 飞了两个多小时，我们才到北京。
sentences.en: Only after flying for over two hours did we arrive in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 现在我已经坐过很多次飞机了，但是我还记得第一次。
sentences.en: Now I've flown many times, but I still remember the first time.

questions.prompt: How old was he on his first flight?
why: Eight o'clock was the flight time.
Five o'clock was when they got up.

questions.prompt: When did they get up that day?
why: Right: 我们五点就起床了.
Eight was when the plane left.
Half past six was when they reached the airport.

questions.prompt: What did he see outside the plane?
why: Right: 外面有很多白色的云.
It was 两个多小时, a little over two hours.
